summary: Shadefall Battlefield is the frontline of eternal war within Discord-Core. War-Shades rise from corrupted earth, Muramite commanders test their armies, and Discord energy saturates the land.
history: War-Shades first manifested here when Discord energy reanimated fallen warriors.
Muramite warlords claimed the battlefield as a proving ground.
Shadow rifts opened, spawning endless waves of spectral combatants.
The Shadefall General emerged as the commander of the War-Shade legions.
